subject.title: fix(sessions): add try-catch wrappers around unprotected JSON.parse calls in session-accessor.sqlite.ts

question: Should malformed canonical transcript rows fail closed for explicit doctor repair, or may runtime readers omit them and continue with incomplete session state?
rationale: Silent lossy recovery is a persistent-state fallback and security/integrity policy choice; repository guidance favors explicit repair, but maintainers must own any intentional degraded-runtime mode.

options.title: Require explicit repair
options.body: Keep runtime reads fail-closed and add diagnosed, tested doctor repair or quarantine for malformed transcript rows.

options.title: Approve lossy recovery
options.body: Allow degraded reads only with explicit corruption diagnostics, preserved row/event correspondence, fail-closed identity behavior, and documented operator recovery.

recommendation.title: Require explicit repair
recommendation.body: Keep runtime reads fail-closed and add diagnosed, tested doctor repair or quarantine for malformed transcript rows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the database-first canonical transcript contract and prior session-corruption policy.
